channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Mystery Skulls Music Pack
item.description: Get into the rhythm with the new Mystery Skulls Music Pack.

item.title: Benny's Backrooms
item.description: A co-op horror where you and your friends (if applicable) explore a seemingly infinite expanse of eerie creature-infested liminal spaces, armed only with a glorified vacuum and specialized equipment to help you locate and extract a rare substance in the name of science.

item.title: Monster Hatcher
item.description: An incremental monster-farming game where you catch and hatch unique creatures, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your skill tree, harvest resources, and battle in idle arenas to become the ultimate monster hatcher.

item.title: Octbuster: Video Rental Store Cleanup
item.description: A physics sim meets a tidy-up game. Octbuster has over 10,000 VHS tapes and an octopus with tentacle arms to scoop them up by the armful. A cart that follows you, a kitten army that helps, an arcade buried under the mess, co-op multiplayer, Twitch chat in your store, and no generative AI.

item.title: Project Exhibitionist
item.description: Project Exhibitionist is a 3D sandbox game about exhibitionism and humiliation. Play as Ciel, a girl who, following a challenge, decides to leave her home completely naked. Discover all the points of interest and create your own story thanks to the game's complete customization.

item.title: Tchia
item.description: A Tropical Open-World adventure. Climb, glide, swim, and sail your boat around a beautiful archipelago in this physics-driven sandbox. Take control of any animal or object you can find, and Jam on your fully playable Ukulele.

item.title: That Which Remains
item.description: 1–4 player sci-fi ghost-hunting horror extraction sim with proximity voice chat. Travel across time to extract resources, identify and capture hostile entities as fuel for a supposed future utopia. Speak to entities using your voice, upgrade your prison, craft tools, and meet a rising daily quota.

item.title: The Long Dark: Iron Road
item.description: THE LONG DARK Survival Expansion. Welcome to Cauldron Island. Lost to history, hiding a mystery. Restore & activate a century-old train to journey deep along the caldera’s spine & uncover a dark secret. What you discover in the end will change how you survive in this Aurora-changed world, forever.

item.title: Culdcept BEGINS
item.description: A hidden classic that fuses board and card games, Culdcept features a unique, innovative system that has captivated fans since its debut. Players become Cepters, wielding cards in intense battles where luck and strategy collide. After ten years, a brand-new story begins once again.

item.title: Liar's Bar
item.description: Dive into this multiplayer online experience set in a sketchy bar where the games are as dangerous as the patrons. Join a table of 4 and test your skills in Liar's Dice and Liar's Deck, where lying and bluffing are key to victory. Ready for a night at Liar's Bar?

item.title: Nomad Drive
item.description: Repair your rundown RV and hit the road solo or in 1–4 player co-op through a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, customize your RV, and survive as long as you can.

item.title: Northgard Battlegrounds
item.description: A city-building auto-battler set in the Viking world of Northgard, where every building you place shapes your clan’s fate. Develop your village, claim the Gods’ blessings, and send your warband to battle against rival players! Every move counts, only one clan will stand.

item.title: Selkie's Salvage&Co.
item.description: Selkie’s Salvage&Co. is a first-person physics based incremental fishing game. Your task is to clean up the flooded planet! Fish up scrap, grind all of it down and collect trinkets of the past. Expand your salvaging operation and go beyond!

item.title: The Boss Gangster: Criminal Empire
item.description: Build a criminal empire from the streets up. Commit crimes in third-person, run and automate illegal businesses, recruit your own crime family, fight rival organizations, and take control of a seamless open-world city.

item.title: Vampy's Big Day
item.description: Sneak through sunlit villages as a clumsy vampire. Move the sun with a fairy's help to cast shadows, then spare or devour the villagers.

item.title: The Last Faith
item.description: Dive into the latest evolution of The Last Faith: a dark and gothic fusion of metroidvania and soulslike. Engage in merciless and precise combat with a huge range of weapons, firearms, and custom executions. Let nothing stand in the way of your journey to salvation.

item.title: Popcorn & Premieren - Ausgehviertel
item.description: Expand your cinema with a leisure district featuring a pizzeria, beach club, restaurant, ice cream café, arcade, bowling, mini golf, stage and event hall. Upgrade businesses, manage your investment and collect parking fees, with real financial risks as well as opportunities.
